why_none: no failure needed it. All 160 are baselined with a node id and now a signature, which is a stronger record than a quarantine: they still RUN, still report, and a change in how they fail is caught.
rules: never reclassify UNKNOWN as environment-only to reduce a failure count
an expired quarantine fails the run rather than lapsing quietly
mechanism: ci_validation.verify_completeness accepts explicit exclusions with a reason and counts them against the planned node set, so a quarantined node is accounted for, not missing
